scope: Reusable constrained Karatsuba operand preparation, with an explicit per-builder cache and setup-owned original-claim composition variant. The default uncached circuit and its historical composition identity remain unchanged. No proof parameters or root obligations are removed.

construction.field: GF(2^128), modulus x^128+x^7+x^2+x+1, little-endian polynomial basis
construction.explanation: Every prepared bit expression and packed Fr wire is derived from the exact original constrained operand bits. The unchanged bounded integer-convolution constraints, Boolean coefficient decompositions, Karatsuba reconstruction and field reduction constrain each product.
construction.integer_embedding: A sixteen-bit polynomial pack is less than 2^80; the integer product is less than 2^160 and therefore below the BLS12-381 scalar modulus. Radix-32 coefficients are bounded without carry aliases.

cache.key: the exact array of 128 source Variable identifiers, never private values
cache.ownership: one R1csBuilder; immutable reference-counted preparations; eviction cannot invalidate a product using an already borrowed preparation
cache.configuration: one explicit enable call on a fresh builder, before any public/private allocation or any constraint, including constant-only equations
cache.constants_and_squares: Shape-time constants and exact same-wire squaring retain the original shortcuts and do not populate the cache. Private zero or one is not a constant.
cache.refusals: Bad capacity, late/repeated enable and ambient cache selection by a composition are rejected. Sticky observer errors cannot return a successful prepared product or completed prefix.

component_plonk_rows.case: four products with one common operand

cost_interpretation: In these complete dense-input components, each reused preparation removes 304 XOR rows and 27*15 affine packing rows: 709 PLONK rows. A single use has the same row count. These counts do not establish the saving for every possible aliased input pattern or the complete verifier.

composition.whole_census_scope: Separate bounded setup-only emission of the whole relation, including public/blinding reservations and hard 2^30 cutoff. A complete setup result must match the subsequent full native replay census. Neither is materialized satisfaction checking, key preprocessing, or a terminal proof.

checks: Materialized cached and manually prepared products match an independent carryless-field oracle, including private zero, nonzero, constants, squares, and high-bit vectors.
Full setup matrices equal assigned matrices for all tested assignments. Every input/output bit and packed preparation wire mutation is rejected by the materialized R1CS.

Exact-wire cache entries remain distinct for equal-valued private operands. Capacities 1, 2 and 4 have bounded deterministic eviction and value-independent projection digests across independent builders.
The default materialized circuit exactly equals the original Karatsuba emission. Existing multiplication golden counts continue to pass.

Actual R1CS-to-PLONK component counts match setup and assigned modes, both manual preparation and automatic cache reuse. Capacity one has no reuse in the measured schedules and retains baseline PLONK row counts.

Three real native Exec proofs pass the explicit arithmetic ownership tests and exact setup/assigned 4096-constraint prefix comparisons. Tables and source-slot counts are unchanged; ambient pre-enabled caches are rejected before emission.
Latest complete ordinary suite: 241 passed, zero failed, 35 ignored. All-target clippy with warnings denied and formatting checks pass.
command: ulimit -v 16777216 && RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4 timeout 180 cargo test --manifest-path flock-stage4/Cargo.toml --release --offline --locked -p ix-fflonk prepared_tests -- --nocapture --test-threads=1
